scope_framing: Mobile movement input currently uses absolute device orientation; user requested delta-style input like mouse movement.
Scope is L1 because behavior is isolated to `Input.js` motion handling and does not require game-rule design.

`js/entities/Player.js` consumes `input.getMoveVector()` and is frozen for this task.

current_direction: Compute motion delta from previous screen-adjusted axes.
Reset baseline on clear and screen-orientation change.

exit_condition_for_next_owner: Motion input is relative/delta-based; first sample and orientation changes do not create jumps; validations are recorded.

build_approval.objective: Change mobile gyro movement from absolute tilt to relative delta input.
runtime_changes: Device orientation events compute movement from deltas between consecutive adjusted samples.
Motion baseline resets on first sample, clear, and screen angle change.
data_tuning_changes: Motion delta sensitivity/deadzone constants local to `Input.js` only.
manual_test_checklist: On mobile, enabling motion while the phone is already tilted must not immediately move the player.
Slowly rotating the phone right/left/up/down must move the player only while rotation changes.
Holding the phone steady after a rotation must stop motion instead of continuing drift from absolute tilt.
Rotating the screen orientation must not produce a large jump.
Desktop keyboard movement and shooting still work.
known_regressions: Sensor noise can create small unintended movement if delta deadzone is too low.
Player currently normalizes non-zero movement vectors, so delta magnitude mostly affects activation threshold, not player speed.
build_approval.impact_guard: Skipped by task-orchestrator because scope is a tiny, single-file input patch with explicit freeze zones and no game-loop/rule changes.

build_input: Approved objective: change mobile gyro movement from absolute tilt to relative delta input.
implementation_summary: Added pending motion delta storage consumed once per `beginFrame()`, so stale sensor deltas do not persist across frames.

Changed device orientation handling to seed baseline on first sample, compute deltas between consecutive screen-adjusted samples, normalize deltas with small deadzone, and accumulate them for next frame.
Reset motion state and baseline on clear and screen-angle change to avoid initial/cross-orientation jumps.
validations_run: PASS: Node sensor simulation: first orientation sample returns zero movement; steady repeated sample returns zero; changed sample returns movement for one frame; following frame without new sensor event returns zero; screen orientation change returns zero.
PASS: Node keyboard simulation: ArrowRight produces `{ dx: 1, dy: 0 }`; key release returns zero.
PASS: JSON parse for new state JSON and log JSONL.
manual_tests: Pending on real mobile hardware: enable motion while phone is already tilted and confirm no immediate player movement.
Pending on real mobile hardware: rotate phone right/left/up/down and confirm movement only while rotation changes.
Pending on real mobile hardware: hold phone steady and confirm no continued drift from absolute tilt.
Pending on real mobile hardware: rotate screen orientation and confirm no large player jump.
Pending in browser: desktop keyboard movement and shooting still work.
known_risks: Real device orientation sensor noise may require tuning the local `deadzone`/`maxDelta` constants after hardware testing.
`Player.update()` normalizes any non-zero movement vector, so gyro delta magnitude controls activation/direction more than speed.
deferred_items: No mobile calibration UI added by scope.
No player movement speed redesign by scope.
